data.one_liner: Turkish case conversion and sorting helpers for Dart strings
data.what_it_does: Provides extension methods to correctly convert strings to upper, lower, and title case in Turkish, and to compare or sort strings according to Turkish locale rules.
use_when: You need Turkish‑specific case conversion that Dart’s core libraries don’t handle correctly
You want to sort or compare strings in Turkish order without writing custom comparators
avoid_when: You are already using platform‑specific locale methods that handle Turkish correctly
You need case handling for multiple locales beyond Turkish
strengths: Simple extension methods that integrate seamlessly with Dart strings
weaknesses: No support for other languages or locale‑aware formatting
